visual_thesis: A colorful Go adventure world first, with compact game UI that frames the Go problem instead of competing with it.

color_roles.background: existing E10 world art, sky/environment color and painted texture; never a plain white replacement
color_roles.surface_panel: sky, cream or illustrated world surface; Deep Navy is structural chrome, not the default card fill
color_roles.inset_panel: light surface step or controlled environmental contrast for detail and comparison
color_roles.primary_frame: Adventure Blue or Go Odyssey Teal edge; Sun Yellow/gold only for special moments
color_roles.secondary_frame: quiet Sky/Teal edge for supporting content
color_roles.hero_frame: bright sky/cream Hero focal surface with Deep Navy identity rail and blue selection
color_roles.monster_frame: tier geometry first; environment color and Deep Navy contrast keep identity readable
color_roles.boss_frame: reinforced darker generic-Boss geometry, warning notch and wider HP rail; never Lord ritual chrome
color_roles.primary_cta: Go Odyssey Teal action surface with Deep Navy text and visible focus treatment
color_roles.secondary_cta: Sky/Cream supporting surface with Adventure Blue edge
color_roles.utility_cta: Deep Navy structural control with an icon and readable label
color_roles.disabled_cta: muted text and dashed border; no misleading glow

background.texture: subtle painted grain or existing E10 world art

item_slot.empty_state: engraved silhouette, not a question mark

reward_card.new_state: NEW ribbon plus short sun-yellow reveal

spirit_frame.material: bright companion surface with constellation/Go-stone motif

glow_roles.active: Go Odyssey Teal, one soft halo
glow_roles.elite: Adventure Blue plus orange edge pulse
glow_roles.legendary: special gold halo with no full-screen bloom
glow_roles.boss: orange/navy warning beat, not a Lord ritual

utility.label_rule: icon may lead, text remains for critical actions

button_hierarchy.focus: visible gold outline and offset, never color-only
button_hierarchy.disabled: reduced contrast plus explanation when actionable context matters

status_presentation.selected: blue outline + Selected label + elevated surface; gold only for high-value selection
status_presentation.locked: lock icon + dashed frame + reason text
status_presentation.new_item: NEW ribbon + sun-yellow accent + one-time reveal motion
status_presentation.equipped: teal ring + Equipped/已裝備 label + slot mark
status_presentation.owned: Owned/已持有 label, no purchase CTA
status_presentation.unavailable: muted art + unavailable reason, no false action
status_presentation.loading: stable skeleton with no layout jump
status_presentation.empty: friendly illustration/shape and next useful action

combat_feedback.correct: brief teal-gold board-edge pulse and readable SUCCESS label
combat_feedback.incorrect: brief warm-red edge shake and coaching copy; do not shame
combat_feedback.damage: server-settled number/popover near Monster, never client-calculated
combat_feedback.defense: shield-shaped neutral/teal cue near Hero, only when committed result says so
combat_feedback.spirit_trigger: small companion orbit cue; no combat effect implied by presentation
combat_feedback.defeat: Monster silhouette fade/knockdown followed by reward transition
combat_feedback.reduced_motion: instant state change with persistent icon/label and no flash

reward_feedback.equipable: Equip / 裝備 primary action only when server capability says so
reward_feedback.consumable: Use / 使用 only when canonical capability says so
reward_feedback.cosmetic: View / 查看 or Collection / 收藏; never fake power delta
reward_feedback.no_drop: brief settlement acknowledgement, no empty roulette state

responsive_contract.desktop_1440x900: world/context and one dominant interaction surface remain visible together
responsive_contract.tablet_landscape: two-column composition; primary surface and contextual identity remain visible
responsive_contract.mobile_390: single-column order: identity -> main interaction -> result/action; 44px targets
responsive_contract.mobile_375: same hierarchy with wrapped labels and no side-by-side micro-panels
responsive_contract.mobile_360: one dominant CTA, compact metadata, no horizontal scroll
responsive_contract.reorder_rule: reorder by player decision, not by shrinking desktop coordinates

accessibility.contrast_target: WCAG AA for text and critical controls
accessibility.traditional_chinese_readability: avoid decorative typeface for body and helper copy

asset_production_note.replacement_requirement: one coherent Go Odyssey icon family preserving slot, rarity and authority semantics
